method: Prices from Inceptron's unauthenticated OpenAI-compatible catalog API https://api.inceptron.io/v1/models (pricing.prompt / pricing.completion in USD per token x 1e6; input_cache_reads is the cache-read tier), cross-checked against OpenRouter endpoint data where provider_name=='Inceptron'. On 2026-07-22 the API lists 4 priced text LLMs: GLM 5.2 $0.94/$2.90, Kimi K2.7 Code $0.72/$3.50, Kimi K2.6 $0.66/$3.41, and MiniMax M2.5 $0.15/$0.90. GLM 5.1 has not returned. OpenRouter now confirms all four live routes (MiniMax M2.5 gained an OpenRouter Inceptron endpoint, slug minimax/minimax-m2.5). HQ Sweden (SE), datacenter Finland (FI) per OpenRouter provider metadata.
